title: Nourishing Roasted German Sevaiiya Noodles
description: A hearty and flavorful German dish featuring roasted sevaiiya noodles, perfect for a crowd, made with sous-vide cooking for tender results and low-glycemic ingredients for a nutritious meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the sevaiiya noodles with olive oil, salt, and black pepper until they are well coated.
Spread the noodles out in a single layer on a large baking sheet and roast in the oven for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally.
While the noodles are roasting, heat the chopped onion and minced garlic in a large skillet over medium heat until the onion is translucent.
Add the sliced bratwurst to the skillet and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the chopped carrots to the skillet and cook for an additional 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
In a large pot, bring the chicken broth to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer.
Add the roasted noodles, cooked bratwurst and carrot mixture, and dried thyme to the pot and stir to combine.
Cook the mixture over low heat for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the flavors have melded together and the noodles are tender.
Serve the noodles hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
